You said:
Can an agent keep querying while a build is running?

ChatGPT said:
Yes. The build holds a writer lock and readers use WAL, so queries continue against the
previously published snapshot.

You said:
What happens to the lock if the build crashes?

ChatGPT said:
It carries a heartbeat. A stale lock is taken over by the next build.
